# binneR ![](reference/figures/binneRsticker.png)

> **Spectral Processing for High Resolution Flow Infusion Mass
> Spectrometry**

A spectral binning approach for flow infusion electrospray high
resolution mass spectrometry (FIE-HRMS) metabolome fingerprinting data.
The package includes an integrated workflow for generating spectrally
binned intensity matrices from converted raw data file formats such as
`.mzML` and `.mzXML`. There are also tools for plotting chromatograms,
spectra and total ion counts.

The methodology is outlined in the article:

[Finch, J.P., Wilson, T., Lyons, L., Phillips, H., Beckmann, M. and
Draper, J., 2022. Spectral binning as an approach to post-acquisition
processing of high resolution FIE-MS metabolome fingerprinting data.
*Metabolomics*, 18(8),
pp.1-9.](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11306-022-01923-6)

### Installation

To download and install this development version run:

``` r

remotes::install_github('aberHRML/binneR')
```

### Learn more

The package documentation can be browsed online at
<https://aberHRML.github.io/binneR/>.

If this is your first time using `binneR` see the
[vignette](https://aberHRML.github.io/binneR/articles/binneR.html) for
information on how to get started.

If you believe you’ve found a bug in `binneR`, please file a bug (and,
if possible, a [reproducible example](https://reprex.tidyverse.org)) at
<https://github.com/aberHRML/binneR/issues>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`BinParameters-class`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/BinParameters-class.md)
  : Spectral binning parameters class
- [`Binalysis-class`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/Binalysis-class.md)
  : Spectral binning analysis class
- [`binParameters()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/binParameters.md)
  : Set spectral binning parameters
- [`binneRlyse()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/binneRlyse.md)
  : Perform spectral binning
- [`detectInfusionScans()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/detectInfusionScans.md)
  : Detect infusion profile scan range
- [`detectParameters()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/detectParameters.md)
  : Detect suitable spectral binning parameters
- [`scans()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/parameters.md)
  [`` `scans<-`() ``](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/parameters.md)
  [`cls()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/parameters.md)
  [`` `cls<-`() ``](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/parameters.md)
  : Get and set spectral binning parameters
- [`plotBin()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/plotBin.md) :
  Plot a spectral bin feature
- [`plotCentrality()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/plotCentrality.md)
  : Plot bin centrality histogram
- [`plotChromFromFile()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/plotChromFromFile.md)
  : Plot an infusion profile chromatogram from a file
- [`plotChromatogram()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/plotChromatogram.md)
  : Plot an infusion profile chromatogram
- [`plotFingerprint()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/plotFingerprint.md)
  : Plot a fingerprint mass spectrum
- [`plotPurity()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/plotPurity.md)
  : Plot bin purity histogram
- [`plotTIC()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/plotTIC.md) :
  Plot sample total ion counts
- [`readBinningParameters()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/readBinningParameters.md)
  : Read binning parameters from file
- [`readFiles()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/readFiles.md)
  : Read and process mulitple data files
- [`version()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/results.md)
  [`creationDate()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/results.md)
  [`filePaths()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/results.md)
  [`sampleInfo()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/results.md)
  [`binnedData()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/results.md)
  [`accurateData()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/results.md)
  [`binningParameters()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/results.md)
  : Binalysis class get methods
- [`show(`*`<BinParameters>`*`)`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/show.md)
  [`show(`*`<Binalysis>`*`)`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/show.md)
  : Show methods for spectral binning classes
- [`singleSample()`](http://aberhrml.github.io/binneR/reference/singleSample.md)
  : Perform single sample spectral binning
